validation: Wrappers call vexel_geometry::affine_valid and validate all points with flatten::bounded before calling shared engines; failures use supplied source_offset.
limits: max_edges is clamped to MAX_PATH_EDGES; engines count preexisting output edges and retain try_reserve and diagnostic behavior.
flatten_cubic_append_contract: Upfront invalid transforms/points leave out unchanged. Recursive flattening may append edges before a later Limit or OutOfMemory error and does not roll back; callers may record out.len() and truncate after failure.
parser_parity: Parser implementation and all nine original integration tests/assertions unchanged.
